messages.en:
{07 16 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} don't you
find fossil hunting to be
surprisingly difficult?
{07 00 00}I've been looking for that
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}fossil{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}
But I just can't seem to
find hide nor hair of it.
Or at least some bones.
I'm so obsessed,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 09 00} even your
face is starting to look
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}-like.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 02 00}Oh!{01 01 00}{07 06 00} If I don't find one soon,
everyone will look like
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} bones!

{07 16 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas sa ei
leia, et fossiilijaht on
üllatavalt raske?
{07 00 00}Olen otsinud seda
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}fossiili{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}
Aga ma ei leia sellest
ei karva ega lõnga.
Või vähemalt mõnda konti.
Olen nii kiiksuga,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 09 00} et isegi
su nägu hakkab tunduma
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}-lik{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 02 00}Oh!{01 01 00}{07 06 00} Kui ma varsti ei leia,
näevad kõik välja nagu
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} kondid!
